toolCalls.arguments:
{"layout":"square","prompt":"Edit the attached product photo (use the provided image as the source). Deliver a square (1:1) catalog-style shot centered on the bottle. Requirements:

1) Remove the window glare/specular reflection on the bottle surface while preserving the bottle's natural gloss and highlights—make reflections consistent and realistic, not flat. Remove only the distracting window reflection; do not change bottle shape, color, or printed label area.

2) Preserve the printed label word-for-word exactly as in the original: do not change any wording, punctuation, capitalization, font appearance, size, placement, or spacing. Keep label colors, texture, and alignment identical. Do not add, remove, or obscure any label text or design elements.

3) Replace the existing background with a uniform warm gray background (neutral warm gray, such as hex #A89F92 or a visually similar warm gray). Make the background seamless and even. Add a subtle, soft shadow beneath the bottle consistent with lighting direction in the original so it sits naturally on the surface.

4) Crop/composition: square crop centered on the bottle with modest breathing room around the product for a catalog look. Keep the bottle fully visible (no cut-off). Make image high resolution, sharp, and color-corrected for accurate product appearance.

5) Deliver the edited image only with no added watermark, text, or logos.

Be sure to inspect the original closely to match label text exactly and to remove only the window glare. Output a single square edited image file."}
toolCalls.name: image_generate
